Field.Description: On Incoming Messages from Firm: Freeform text field to identify a strategy description, up to 80 characters; only printable ASCII characters allowed, excluding comma, semicolon, pipe delimiter, "at" symbol, greater than/less than, ampersand (&) and single/double quotation mark. However, will not be passed back in Acknowledgments or any subsequent response messages. On Outgoing Messages from Exchan

Field.Name: TimeinForce
Field.Description: 0 = Day 1 = GTC 2 = At the Opening 3 = IOC 4 = FOK 5 = GTX 6 = GTD 7 = On Close

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: On Incoming Messages from Firm: Customer application time. On Outgoing Message from Exchange: Exchange application time. UTC time, in Milliseconds YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: 0 - 999,999 When MultiLegReportingType [442] = 2, this field represents the leg level quantity.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of Options Instrument OPT = Single leg Option MLEG = Complex Option Value is 'MLEG' when MultiLegReportingType [442] = 2 or 3.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Maturity day. Part of Options series identifier. DD Not provided when MultiLegReportingType [442] = 3.

Field.Name: TradeCondition
Field.Description: e = Single Leg Floor Trade i = Complex Order to Complex Order Floor Trade m = Complex Order to Single Leg Order Floor Trade p = Complex Order with Stock to Complex Order with Stock Floor Trade s = Complex Order with Stock to Single Leg Order Floor Trade

Field.Name: NoTradingSessions
Field.Description: 1 1 = Early Trading Session 2 = Core Trading Session 3 = Late Trading Session 4 = Early & Core Trading Sessions 5 = Core & Late Trading Sessions 6 = Early, Core, & Late Trading Sessions

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of Contra Brokers → Repeating group ContraBroker [375] is the first tag in this repeating group. Contra party clearing number of CMTA Contra party Firm Identifier - MPID

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Clearing number of CMTA. Numeric characters only, no preceding zeros.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Clearing number, if other than a default Clearing Number. If not specified, a system or customer assigned default clearing number will be sent back on response messages. Numeric characters only, no preceding zeros.

Field.Name: MultilegReportingType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of Execution Report. (e.g. used with multi-leg securities, such as option strategies, spreads, etc.). 1 = Single-leg security 2 = Individual leg of a multi-leg security 3 = Multi-leg security

Field.Name: OptionalData
Field.Description: Clearing Optional Data Customer defined up to 16 characters; only printable ASCII characters allowed, excluding comma, semicolon, pipe delimiter, "at" symbol, greater than/less than, ampersand (&) and single/double quotation mark.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the individual leg of the new Complex Order or Complex Cancel/Replace request as assigned by the firm. Only provided when MultiLegReportingType [442] = 2.

Field.Name: SelfTradeType
Field.Description: 0 (number 0) = Use current Session Configuration STP setting for the SenderCompID T = No Self Trade Prevention N = Cancel Newest O (letter O)= Cancel Oldest C = Cancel Both D = Cancel Decrement* *Not supported on NYSE Arca/American Options

Field.Name: CapStrategyID
Field.Description: Strategy Execution Fee cap identifier, as agreed upon between firms and Exchange.

Field.Name: SpecialOrdType
Field.Description: 1 = DMM Open/Re-open/Close with or without Auction (AOC) - drop copy only 2 = DMM Pre-auction - drop copy only 3 = DMM After-auction - drop copy only 9 = Cabinet C = Customer to Customer Cross P = CUBE Price Improvement Q = QCC S = AON CUBE T = QCT (DeliverToComp ID must be populated with IB Firm Identifier)

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: A = Add Liquidity Only (ALO) 0 = No trade against MPL 2 = No route to IOI 3 = No trade against MPL and no route to IOI 4 = Retail Order Type 1 5 = Retail Order Type 2 7 = Retail Provider 8 = Imbalance Offset C = Complex Order Auction 9 = Discretionary Peg D = Dark (Non-Displayed) Primary Peg I = Issuer Direct Offering (IDO) N = Add Liquidity Only (Non-Taking ALO) O = Open Outcry B = Clear the Book

Field.Name: IntroducingBadgeID
Field.Description: Initiating Broker Badge, 1-4 numeric characters. Required on orders from NYSE Arca/American Options Floor Broker OMS to Pillar.

Field.Name: DealID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of a transaction, assigned to both sides of a single trade. Numerical up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: LiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: ZOS = Open outcry for Single leg ZOC = Open outcry for a leg that is part of a Complex order Partial Fills and Fills

Field.Name: FlowIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether a corresponding inbound message was throttled. For outgoing messages without a corresponding inbound message, the tag will default to 0. 0 = Inbound message was not throttled 1 = Inbound message was throttled

Field.Name: NanosecondTransactTime
Field.Description: Exchange application time. UTC time, in Nanoseconds - YYYYMMDD‐HH:MM:SS.sssssssss Note: this represents the same reference time as provided in the standard FIX tag TransactTime [60], with more granular resolution.

Field.Name: ContraCustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Contra party capacity of the order 0 = Customer 1 = Firm 2 = Broker 3 = Market maker 4 = Away Market Maker 8 = Prof customer

Field.Name: ContraClearingAccount
Field.Description: Contra party clearing number

Field.Name: ContraOpenClose
Field.Description: Contra party position in the Option O = Open C = Close

Field.Name: ContraMarketMaker
Field.Description: Contra party MMID

Field.Name: AllocationFirmMPID
Field.Description: Identifier of the allocated party - MPID. May be populated with: Initiating Broker MPID - for self- allocation. Broker must specify self- allocation on at least one side of every allocation pair. The MPID populated in this tag must match the MPID specified in OnBehalfOfCompID [115].

Field.Name: AllocationFirmMMID
Field.Description: Identifier of the allocated party - MMID. May be populated with: Third party MMID - allocation will be considered pending until the third party approves the allocation via NYSE Pillar Trade Ops Portal.

Field.Name: AllocationFirmIntroducingBadgeID
Field.Description: Identifier of the allocated party - Broker Badge. May be populated with: Third party Broker Badge - allocation will be considered pending until the third party approves the allocation via NYSE Pillar Trade Ops Portal.

Field.Name: PercentageStrike
Field.Description: FLEX orders with percent of the underlying price represented as the Strike Price. 0.01 - 9,999.99

Field.Name: PercentagePrice
Field.Description: FLEX orders with percent of the underlying price represented as the Premium Price. 0.01 - 9,999.99

Field.Name: TiedHedgeIndicator
Field.Description: Y = order is a tied hedge N = order is NOT a tied hedge

Field.Name: TiedToStock
Field.Description: Y = order is tied to stock N = order is NOT tied to stock

Field.Name: RefDelta
Field.Description: Required if TiedToStock [20035] = Y Numeric only - decimal supported. May be positive or negative.

Field.Name: StockPrice
Field.Description: Required if TiedToStock [20035] = Y For market orders that are tied-to-stock and this value is unknown at the time of order entry, enter 999,999,999.99. 0.000001 - 999,999,999.999999

Field.Name: StockQty
Field.Description: Required if TiedToStock [20035] = Y 1 - 999,999,999

Field.Name: PackageLinkID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the single leg or complex Order or Cancel/Replace request, as assigned by the firm. This field is to be used to link orders together that cannot be facilitated using the complex message structure.

Field.Name: BestBidQty
Field.Description: Quantity the Initiating Broker would be obligated to satisfy if trading at the BestBidPrice [20029]. Clear the Book quantity at the BBO 0 - 999,999 Not provided when MultiLegReportingType [442] = 3.

Field.Name: BestBidPrice
Field.Description: Best prevailing bid for NYSE Arca or NYSE American. 0.00000000 - 9,999.99

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Returned from the Cancel or Cancel/Replaced Request - the ClOrdID of the message that is rejected (Cancel or Cancel/Replace request). Pillar will validate that the ClOrdID is unique for the combination of SenderCompID + OnBehalfOfCompID (MPID) that entered the order, among open orders only. However, the firm is responsible for ensuring that the ClOrdID provided is unique among all orders sent for

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID of the order intended for cancellation or replacement. Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by the Exchange. Numerical up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of the order: 0 = New 1 = Partially Filled 2 = Filled 3 = Done For Day 4 = Cancelled 5 = Replaced 6 = Pending Cancel 8 = Rejected C = Billable Cancel (Self Trade Prevention) E = Pending Replace G = Pillar OMS Allocation Pending H = Pillar OMS Allocation Reject J = Pillar OMS Trade Reject K= OMS Allocation Request M = Pending Modify N = Broker Open Outcry Announcement P = Trading Official Op

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Returned from Order Cancel or Cancel/Replace Request. Represents the ClOrdID of the previously entered order intended for cancellation or replacement (NOT necessarily the initial order of the day). Customer defined up to 20 chars; only printable ASCII characters allowed, excluding comma, semicolon, pipe delimiter, "at" symbol, greater than/less than, ampersand (&) and single/double quotation mark.

However, will not be passed back in Acknowledgments or any subsequent response messages. On Outgoing Message from Exchang
